lines.name: The Dragonborn
lines.about: Dragons have come back to Skyrim, and this is the story of the Dragonborn sent to stop Alduin, starting with a dragon attack on Helgen and running through Whiterun, High Hrothgar, the Blades and beyond. It has 19 story quests plus four side jobs for the Greybeards and the Blades; the records set no level for it.

getIn.how: Pick the Dragonborn start ("You are the Dragonborn of legend, saving the world from Alduin.") at Helgen Keep, either at its start or its end, and escape the dragon attack.

order.what: Escape Helgen through the keep during a dragon attack, with Hadvar or Ralof.
Go to Riverwood, then tell Jarl Balgruuf in Dragonsreach about the dragon.
Fetch the Dragonstone from Bleak Falls Barrow for Farengar, the Jarl's court wizard.
Go with Irileth to the Western Watchtower, where a dragon is attacking, then report back to the Jarl.
Climb from Ivarstead to High Hrothgar and train with the Greybeards.
Retrieve the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller from Ustengrav for Arngeir.
Meet Delphine in the attic room of the Sleeping Giant Inn, then go to Kynesgrove and kill the dragon Sahloknir.
order.where: Sleeping Giant Inn, Riverwood, and Kynesgrove

order.what: Get into the Thalmor Embassy, either at the ambassador's party with Delphine's help or by storming it, and search it.
Find Esbern, a Blade hiding in the Ratway under Riften.
Take Esbern to Delphine in Riverwood, then find Sky Haven Temple past the Forsworn camp at Karthspire.
Learn Clear Skies from the Greybeards and climb to Paarthurnax at the summit.
Find the Elder Scroll, by way of the College of Winterhold, Septimus Signus, Alftand and Blackreach, at the Tower of Mzark.
Read the Elder Scroll at the Time-Wound on the summit.
Find a way to trap a dragon in Dragonsreach and question it.
Arrange a truce in the civil war at a council at High Hrothgar, so the Jarl of Whiterun will help.
order.needs: Only while the civil war is still being fought

order.what: Free Odahviing and let him fly you to Skuldafn.
Cross the mist of Sovngarde to the Hall of Valor.
Help the heroes in the Hall of Valor drive off the mist and face Alduin.
Decide Paarthurnax's fate after Delphine and Esbern demand his death.
A radiant job that can come up when you enter High Hrothgar: find a Word of Power in a dungeon the game picks. It isn't a step in the story.
order.where: a dungeon with a word wall, chosen by the game

order.what: Bring followers to Delphine to join the Blades.
A radiant job from Esbern: kill the dragon in a lair the game picks and report back. It isn't a step in the story.
order.where: a dragon lair chosen by the game
order.needs: Ask Esbern about dragon lairs at the end of Rebuilding the Blades

order.what: Bring Esbern 3 Dragon Blood, 3 Dragon Bile and 3 Dragon Rheum.

options: Enter the keep with Hadvar (Imperial); he sends you to his uncle Alvor in Riverwood
Enter the keep with Ralof (Stormcloak); he sends you to his sister Gerdur in Riverwood
Go to the ambassador's party as a guest, with Delphine and Malborn's help
What you agree to at the peace council; the records name holds and two towns (Karthwasten and Darkwater Crossing) that can be traded, but not the terms
Kill Paarthurnax, as the Blades ask
Spare him and talk Delphine and Esbern round

gives: Thane of Whiterun, with Lydia as your housecarl (Dragon Rising)
Blade of Whiterun, a greatsword, and enchanted armour from Requiem's reward list (Dragon Rising)

Shouts: words of Unrelenting Force and Whirlwind Sprint (The Way of the Voice), a word from Wulfgar (The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller), Clear Skies and a word of Fire Breath (The Throat of the World), Dragonrend (Alduin's Bane) and Call Dragon (The Fallen)
The power of the dragons you kill at the Western Watchtower and at Kynesgrove (Dragon Rising, A Blade in the Dark)
Elder Scroll (Dragon) (Elder Knowledge)
closes: Paarthurnax dies if you kill him (Paarthurnax)
Alduin is destroyed and the main story ends (Dragonslayer)
Helgen as a living town: its inn, houses and shops can be shut away; the records don't show when (Unbound)
Season Unending is held between the civil war's two sides, so it overlaps the civil war line; what the truce changes isn't in the records

unsure.why: No minimum level or level gate for this line is in the records (no GetLevel condition on its opening), so the level it is made for isn't given.

A note in the Resting Pilgrim in Helgen says talking to Matlara about staying longer may start something; whether that is a way in from other starts or part of the Dragonborn start isn't in the records. How the line begins after other character starts isn't shown either.
Paarthurnax: no record shows which earlier quest must be done before Delphine and Esbern turn on him.

Rebuilding the Blades and Dragon Research: nothing in the records shows what starts them; they likely follow Alduin's Wall, when Delphine and Esbern move into Sky Haven Temple. Paarthurnax Quest Expansion edits them, so the Paarthurnax choice may lock or delay them.
Season Unending: if the civil war is already over, the truce step may be skipped; the script that decides this isn't in the records.
The Jarl's armour rewards in Before the Storm and Dragon Rising are Requiem leveled lists; which piece you get isn't shown.
If you spare Paarthurnax, whether the Blades refuse to help you for good or only until you talk them round isn't in the records.

lines.name: Dawnguard
lines.about: Vampires are stirring in Skyrim, and this story has you choose between the Dawnguard vampire hunters at Fort Dawnguard, southeast of Riften, and the vampire court of Lord Harkon at Castle Volkihar. Each side has about a dozen story quests, with radiant jobs for the side you choose; the records set no level for it.

getIn.where: Fort Dawnguard, inside Dayspring Canyon southeast of Riften
getIn.how: Once you hear that the Dawnguard vampire hunters are looking for recruits, the journal sends you to speak with their leader at Fort Dawnguard.

order.what: Hear that the Dawnguard are recruiting and go to Fort Dawnguard to speak with their leader.
Report to Isran after refusing Harkon, then recruit Sorine Jurard, Gunmar and Florentius Baenius.
order.where: Fort Dawnguard, a Dwemer ruin in the Reach and Ruunvald Excavation

order.what: Rescue Florentius Baenius, a former priest of Arkay, from Ruunvald Excavation so he joins the Dawnguard.
A radiant Dawnguard job: quietly kill a vampire posing as a local in a town the game picks.
order.needs: On the Dawnguard side (you refused Harkon in Bloodline)

order.what: A radiant Dawnguard job: kill the boss of a dungeon the game picks.
A radiant Dawnguard job: kill a vampire in a dungeon before it turns its allies into vampires.
A radiant Dawnguard job: track a vampire through its contact in a town, then kill it in its lair.
order.where: a town and a dungeon the game picks

order.what: A radiant Dawnguard job for Sorine Jurard: fetch a piece of old technology from a dungeon for her crossbow work.
A radiant Dawnguard job: free someone a vampire has kidnapped.
A radiant Dawnguard job: warn a Jarl about a vampire posing as a visiting advisor and destroy it.
order.where: a hold capital the game picks

order.what: A radiant Dawnguard job: recover an old Dawnguard relic from a dungeon.
A radiant job for Harkon's court from Fura Bloodmouth or Garan Marethi: kill a Dawnguard member hiding in a town.
order.needs: In Harkon's court (you accepted his gift in Bloodline)

order.what: A radiant job for Harkon's court: kill the creature in a dungeon the game picks.
A radiant job for Harkon's court: kill someone in a city's streets and plant a letter blaming the Dawnguard.
A radiant job for Harkon's court: kill a rogue vampire before it turns its allies.
A radiant job for Harkon's court: fetch old remains from a dungeon to strengthen the Bloodstone Chalice.
A radiant job for Harkon's court: turn your spouse into a vampire.
A radiant job for Harkon's court: turn a chosen person into a vampire.
A radiant job for Harkon's court: fetch the Ring of the Beast and the Ring of the Erudite from two dungeons.
A radiant job for Harkon's court: fetch the Amulet of Bats and the Amulet of the Gargoyle.
A job from Garan Marethi: attack Fort Dawnguard and kill its leaders.
Fill the Bloodstone Chalice at the bloodspring in Redwater Den and bring it back to Garan Marethi.
Isran sends you to Dimhollow Crypt to find out what the vampires are looking for.
Take Serana home to Castle Volkihar and answer her father Lord Harkon's offer.
The Dawnguard version: follow the moth priest's trail from the Winking Skeever and Dragon Bridge and rescue him from Forebears' Holdout.
Harkon's court version: follow the moth priest's trail from the Winking Skeever and Dragon Bridge and capture him at Forebears' Holdout.
order.needs: Accept Harkon's gift in Bloodline; the Vampire's Seduction power for the moth priest

order.what: Search Castle Volkihar with Serana for the trail of her mother Valerica.
Find Valerica in the Soul Cairn and recover the Elder Scroll (Blood).
order.needs: To pass the portal, become a vampire or let Serana partly soul trap you

order.what: Do the moth priests' ritual in the Ancestor Glade so you can read the Elder Scrolls yourself.
order.needs: All three Elder Scrolls: Sun, Dragon and Blood

order.what: Go through Darkfall Cave into the Forgotten Vale for Auriel's Bow.
order.where: Darkfall Cave and the Forgotten Vale

order.what: Confront Lord Harkon at Castle Volkihar with Auriel's Bow.
Find the Elder Scroll (Dragon) and the Elder Scroll (Blood) and bring them to Dexion Evicus.
Ask Urag gro-Shub in the Arcanaeum about the Elder Scroll (Dragon), or buy it back from him if you sold it.
Find the ten pages of Saint Jiub's Opus for Jiub in the Soul Cairn.
Find Arvak's skull in the Soul Cairn for a rider's soul there.
Make a pact with the dragon Durnehviir in the Soul Cairn and summon him in Skyrim.
order.where: Durnehviir's lair in the Soul Cairn

order.what: A journal objective pointing you to Durnehviir's lair in the Soul Cairn.
Bring the Ancient Falmer Tomes from the Forgotten Vale to Urag gro-Shub.
order.where: the Forgotten Vale and the Arcanaeum

order.what: A tutorial for your first Vampire Lord transformation; LoreRim likely skips it.

options: Accept Lord Harkon's gift of his blood: you become a vampire and join his court
Refuse it: you are sent away and return to the Dawnguard
Let Serana turn you into a vampire to pass the portal
Let Serana partly soul trap you and pass it still mortal
Dawnguard side: rally the Dawnguard with Isran and attack Castle Volkihar
Harkon's court side: confront Harkon yourself

gives: Harkon's gift: you become a vampire and join his court, if you accept (Bloodline)
Auriel's Bow (Touching the Sky)
Elder Scroll (Blood) (Beyond Death)
Summon Durnehviir and all three words of Soul Tear, and Durnehviir fights at your side when summoned (Durnehviir)
Summon Arvak (Soul Cairn Horse Quest)
Locket of Saint Jiub: "Saint Jiub's grace invigorates your muscles, increasing your Stamina and Carry Weight capacity by 50 points." (Impatience of a Saint)
Sorine Jurard, Gunmar and Florentius Baenius join the Dawnguard at Fort Dawnguard (A New Order, Bolstering the Ranks)
closes: Bloodline sets which side you play for the rest of the line: Harkon's court or the Dawnguard
Lord Harkon dies (Kindred Judgment)
Arch-Curate Vyrthur dies (Touching the Sky)
Stalf and Salonia Caelia die (The Bloodstone Chalice)
The three Boneyard Keepers die (Beyond Death)
Dexion Evicus is left blind and can't read the scrolls any more (Seeking Disclosure)
On Harkon's side: the Dawnguard leaders are targets in Destroying the Dawnguard (Isran, Sorine Jurard, Gunmar, Florentius Baenius, Agmaer, Durak, Celann and Beleval)
Your spouse becomes a vampire (The Gift); the person you bite becomes a vampire (New Allegiances)

unsure.why: No minimum level or level gate for this line is in the records (the opening has no dialogue or event conditions), so the level it is made for isn't given.
Who first tells you the Dawnguard are recruiting isn't in the records; the opening quest has no start line, event or script in these files.

The radiant jobs' offer conditions aren't in the records; which side each belongs to comes from the job system that starts it. For New Allegiances, Rings of Blood Magic, Amulets of Night Power and Destroying the Dawnguard, nothing limits them to Harkon's court, though they are handed out at Castle Volkihar.
Whether the radiant jobs repeat isn't shown; the quest records carry no repeat flag. Their payment is likely gold and a leveled list held by the job system, but which job pays what isn't recorded.

Both Prophet versions likely follow A New Order or The Bloodstone Chalice; their journals only say "when I returned", and the records don't show the link. Bolstering the Ranks overlaps A New Order's own Florentius step in a way the records don't show.
Power of the Blood: Skip Vampire Lord Tutorial edits it last, but the change isn't shown, so that it's skipped comes from that plugin's name.
Whether you can change sides after Bloodline isn't in the records. Whether a player who is already a vampire gets the Chasing Echoes choice isn't shown.

A Vampire Lord Ornament is held by Kindred Judgment's script, and the Dawnguard War Axe by Bloodline's; whether either is given to you, and on which side, isn't shown. Whether you keep the rings and amulets from the court's jobs isn't shown either.
In Destroying the Dawnguard, whether every one of the eight must die, or whether any are protected, isn't in the records.

lines.name: Dragonborn
lines.about: A story on the island of Solstheim, reached by boat from Windhelm, about another Dragonborn named Miraak and the Black Books that lead into Apocrypha. It has seven story quests and starts when Miraak's cultists attack you in Skyrim; the records set no level for it.

getIn.where: out in Skyrim, wherever they ambush you
getIn.how: When cultists attack you, search their bodies and read the Cultists' Orders; they send you to the boat at Windhelm that goes to Solstheim.

order.what: Take the boat from Windhelm to Raven Rock, ask the townsfolk about Miraak and find his temple.
order.where: Raven Rock and the Temple of Miraak, Solstheim

order.what: Meet Frea at the Temple of Miraak and search it for the source of Miraak's power.
Go with Frea to Skaal Village, learn the word at Saering's Watch and free the Wind Stone with Bend Will.
order.where: Skaal Village, Saering's Watch and the Wind Stone

order.what: Free the Water, Earth, Beast and Sun Stones with Bend Will for Storn Crag-Strider.
order.where: the stones around Raven Rock and Skaal Village

order.what: Ask Neloth at Tel Mithryn about the Black Books, then recover one from the Dwemer city of Nchardak.
Read the Black Book in Nchardak, meet Hermaeus Mora in Apocrypha and bring Storn what he asks.
Go to Apocrypha and make for Miraak's temple to face him.
The cultist ambush out in Skyrim that likely sets off Dragonborn: search the cultists' bodies. It isn't a step of its own.

gives: Bend Will (Shout), all three words: one from Saering's Watch (The Fate of the Skaal), one from Hermaeus Mora and one when Storn reads the book (The Gardener of Men)
Forging Solstheim and Dunmer armour (Bonemold, Chitin, Netch Leather, Ashlander, Redoran, Indoril and more) once you have the Craftsmanship perk (Dragonborn)
closes: Storn Crag-Strider dies (The Gardener of Men)
Miraak dies (At the Summit of Apocrypha)

unsure.why: No minimum level or level gate for this line is in the records; the level or timing at which the cultist ambush fires isn't recorded (Requiem and LoreRim's own plugins edit the encounter, but the changes aren't shown).

Dragonborn has a second journal line for arriving on Solstheim, so you may be able to pick the line up by sailing there without the note; the trigger isn't in the records. No record links the ambush encounter to the quest directly.
The Temple of Miraak has two openings (reaching the temple, or Storn sending you after the Skaal are freed); what triggers each isn't shown.
Which point in Dragonborn opens the Solstheim and Dunmer armour recipes isn't recorded. Whether Waking Dreams or Miraak's mask are given to you isn't shown.

lines.name: The Companions
lines.about: The Companions are a guild of warriors based at Jorrvaskr in Whiterun; you join them, take jobs from their members and rise through their ranks. The story has seven quests, with radiant jobs from Aela, Farkas, Skjor and Vilkas alongside; the records set no level for it.

getIn.who: Aela the Huntress, Farkas, Skjor or Vilkas, then Kodlak Whitemane
getIn.where: Jorrvaskr, Whiterun; Kodlak is in his quarters downstairs at the end of the hall
getIn.how: Ask one of the Companions about joining; they send you to Kodlak, who lets you join if you handle some first tasks.

order.what: Ask to join, spar with Vilkas in the yard and take his sword to Eorlund Gray-Mane at the Skyforge.
Fetch a fragment of Wuuthrad from Dustman's Cairn while a Companion watches you.
Follow the Companion who greets you on your return to your induction.
Meet Skjor beneath the Skyforge at night, then attack the Silver Hand at Gallows Rock with Aela and Skjor.
order.where: the Underforge and Gallows Rock, Eastmarch

order.what: Bring Kodlak Whitemane the head of a Glenmoril Witch from Glenmoril Coven.
Go with Vilkas to Driftshade Sanctuary, the Silver Hand stronghold, for the fragments of Wuuthrad.
Have Eorlund mend Wuuthrad at the Skyforge and take it to Ysgramor's Tomb.
order.where: Whiterun and Ysgramor's Tomb, Winterhold hold
order.needs: A Glenmoril Witch's head from Blood's Honor

order.what: A radiant job from Aela: kill an animal that got into a home in a town she picks.
A radiant job from Aela: clear out an animal den she picks.
A radiant job from Aela: bring back the pelts she asks for.
A radiant job from Farkas: rough up a troublemaker in the town he names, without killing them.
A radiant job from Farkas: kill the leader of a hideout causing trouble in one of the holds.
A radiant job from Skjor, or from Vilkas once Skjor is dead: take back a family's stolen valuable from a hideout.
A radiant job from Skjor, or from Vilkas once Skjor is dead: track down and kill an escaped criminal on the roads of a hold.
A radiant job from Vilkas: rescue a captive from a lair and see them home alive.
A radiant job from Aela against the Silver Hand: kill a lieutenant at a camp she names.
order.where: a Silver Hand camp Aela picks

order.what: A radiant job from Aela against the Silver Hand: steal their plans from a lieutenant's camp.
order.where: a Silver Hand camp Aela picks

order.what: A radiant job from Aela against the Silver Hand: take back a fragment of Wuuthrad from one of their camps.
order.where: a Silver Hand camp Aela picks

order.what: A radiant job from Aela: fetch a Totem of Hircine from a dungeon with her and set it in the Underforge.
order.where: a dungeon Aela picks, and the Underforge

order.what: Help Farkas or Vilkas be cured the way Kodlak was, with a Glenmoril Witch's head at Ysgramor's Tomb.
A radiant job from Vilkas or Farkas: kill a dragon with him at a lair the game picks.
order.where: a dragon lair the game picks
order.needs: From Vilkas only once Skjor is dead

gives: Membership of the Companions, with a bed in Jorrvaskr (Take Up Arms)
Beast Form, at the blood ritual where you join the Circle and become a werewolf (The Silver Hand)
Wuuthrad, a battleaxe (Glory of the Dead)
Shield of Ysgramor (Glory of the Dead)
Harbinger of the Companions (Glory of the Dead)
closes: Skjor dies at the Silver Hand stronghold (The Silver Hand)
Kodlak Whitemane is killed by the Silver Hand (Blood's Honor)
The brother you cure is no longer a werewolf (Purity)

unsure.why: No minimum level for this line is in the records, so the level it is made for isn't given.

A dialogue mod puts a check on some opening lines: one of One-Handed, Two-Handed, Archery or Block at 30 or more, or Health or Stamina at 150 or more, with LoreRim's dialogue patch keeping it. The line text isn't in the records, so whether this stops you joining is unsettled; Farkas, Skjor and Vilkas also have lines that send you to Kodlak.

How many jobs you must do before Proving Honor, and how many of Aela's Silver Hand jobs before Blood's Honor, isn't in the records. The radiant jobs' offer conditions aren't recorded, and whether they repeat isn't shown.
Totems of Hircine lists no requirement; the totem goes to the Underforge, which you first enter in The Silver Hand.
Whether you can turn down the blood ritual in The Silver Hand isn't shown. Whether both brothers can be cured in turn in Purity isn't shown.
The Silver Hand's script holds one Skyforge Steel weapon per weapon type; how one is picked or when it's given isn't shown. The Companions' payment for jobs isn't recorded.

lines.name: The College of Winterhold
lines.about: The College of Winterhold is the mages' school in Winterhold; you join by casting a spell for Faralda at its entrance, and its story starts with an expedition to the ruins of Saarthal. The story has eight quests, with lessons, ritual spells and radiant jobs from the College's scholars alongside; the records set no level for it.

getIn.where: at the entrance to the College of Winterhold, in Winterhold
getIn.how: Talk to Faralda and cast the one spell she asks for: Magelight, a Flame Atronach, Firebolt, Fear, or Healing Hands on her.

order.what: Pass Faralda's spell test, tour the College with Mirabelle Ervine and attend Tolfdir's first lesson.
Join Tolfdir's expedition to the dig at Saarthal and tell Savos Aren what you find.
Recover the books Orthorn stole for Urag gro-Shub from Fellglow Keep.
Tell Tolfdir about the Night of Tears book, meet Quaranir of the Psijic Order and find the Augur of Dunlain in the Midden.
order.where: College of Winterhold and the Midden

order.what: Find the Arch-Mage in the Hall of the Elements and fight off the Magic Anomalies in Winterhold.
order.needs: Finish Revealing the Unseen (listed after it)

order.what: Find the Synod researchers at Mzulft, get the focusing crystal back from the Falmer and work the Oculory.
Find the Staff of Magnus in Labyrinthian.
Use the Staff of Magnus to get back into the College and face Ancano.
A radiant job from Urag gro-Shub: find a copy of Shalidor's writings at a place the game picks.
Close a Rupture in one of Skyrim's holds for Tolfdir.
Be the test subject for Brelyna Maryon's new spells.
Test J'zargo's Flame Cloak scrolls three times against the undead.
Get Onmund's family amulet back from Enthir, who wants a staff from a dungeon first.
order.where: College of Winterhold and a dungeon the game picks

order.what: Bring Arniel Gane ten Dwarven cogs (part one of four).
Get Enthir to finish a trade with Arniel by fetching the staff he wants from a dungeon (part two).
Charge Arniel's warped soul gem in Dwarven convectors, Mzulft among them (part three).
Find Arniel's missing courier, bring back the package and watch his experiment (part four).
order.where: a dungeon the game picks and the College

order.what: Pay Tolfdir to lift a suspension from the College.
Ask Faralda for more Destruction training and follow the book Power of the Elements to Master Destruction spells.
order.where: Hall of the Elements, College of Winterhold

order.what: Cast Drevis Neloren's Vision of the Tenth Eye and find the four Master Illusion texts hidden around the College.
order.where: the College's halls, the Arcanaeum and the Midden

order.what: Summon and subdue an Unbound Dremora so it fetches Phinis Gestor a sigil stone.

unsure.why: No minimum level for this line is in the records, so the level it is made for isn't given. Labyrinthian's enemies start at level 24 in LoreRim, which is the only level figure tied to the story.

The script that picks Faralda's test spell isn't in the records. A College entry mod and Requiem change the conditions on her entry lines (item checks, a 'Faralda sells spells' setting that is off, and The Way of the Voice for one line); the line text isn't recorded, so other ways in can't be confirmed.

For the scholars' side quests and ritual spells, the conditions on the opening lines aren't in the records, so College membership or a skill level isn't confirmed; the ritual spells' rewards are Master spells listed at skill 100.
College Curriculum's own start isn't in the records; its first lesson (Rapture of the Deep) comes before the other scholars' lessons according to its journal.
Rogue Wizard has no start line, event or journal text in the records.

Whether you keep Kahvozein's Fang after the Alteration ritual isn't shown. Which of the Illusion and Conjuration tomes you get isn't shown. Good Intentions holds a Mage's Circlet leveled list whose contents aren't recorded.
Which Research Thief ending goes with which choice isn't in the records.
